records.title: P2-ViT: Power-of-Two Post-Training Quantization and Acceleration for Fully Quantized Vision Transformer
records.reason: P2-ViT applies power-of-two post-training quantization to fully quantized vision transformers and evaluates accuracy/acceleration; the method is vision-specific, so transfer to the linked language quantization lineage is unclear.

records.title: LLM4HAR: Generalizable On-device Human Activity Recognition with Pretrained LLMs
records.reason: The ACM primary article endpoint returned HTTP 403 and no author/institution full text was accessible; the title/abstract indicates on-device HAR with pretrained LLMs, but efficiency mechanisms and evaluation could not be verified from full text.

records.title: Discovering sentiment insights: streamlining tourism review analysis with Large Language Models
records.reason: The full open-access study compares zero-shot and fine-tuned models for tourism-review sentiment and keyword extraction; it is an application evaluation and does not introduce an inference optimization.

records.title: Hardware–Software Co-Design Enabling Static and Dynamic Sparse Attention Mechanisms
records.reason: The IEEE publisher endpoint was inaccessible and no primary full-text copy was retrieved; the record describes hardware/software co-design for sparse attention, but hardware assumptions and measured results could not be checked.

records.title: Revisiting Compositional Generalization Capability of Large Language Models Considering Instruction Following Ability
records.reason: The paper evaluates compositional generalization and instruction-following ability of LLMs; its experiments concern task generalization rather than compute, memory, latency, or serving efficiency.
